intro: Show Twitch polls, Twitch predictions and YouTube polls on stream as live cards with vote bars, a countdown and the winner highlighted. Results come from Streamer.bot's own poll and prediction events, so no import or extra trigger is needed.

sections.title: 1. Choose what to show
sections.description: Start a poll or prediction on Twitch or YouTube as usual and its card appears.

sections.title: 2. Look and sound
sections.description: Numbers, wording, sounds and where the cards sit.
